name: runai-get-cluster-health-summary
description: Point-in-time Run:ai cluster and node-health check: a HEALTHY, DEGRADED, or STUCK verdict per node pool with the dominant blocker — NotReady nodes, offline or failing GPU capacity, GPU counts, allocation vs utilization, the pending backlog, and a stuck scheduler vs a full pool. Use for "is the cluster healthy?", "is the scheduler stuck?", "any nodes down?", "are GPUs failing?", "how many GPUs are free?", "is the cluster saturated?", or "why isn't node pool X scheduling?". Not for quota fairness, team GPU waste, one workload, failed-workload node correlation, XID errors on one node, or writes.
